claims.text: The hotel is at 1088 Xingye Road in Shenzhen's Bao'an District.

findings.quote: 1088 Xingye Road, Bao’an District, Shenzhen, Guangdong, China, 518101

claims.text: Shenzhen Bao'an International Airport is about 20 km from the hotel.

findings.quote: SZX is located approximately 20.0 KM from the hotel.

claims.text: The rooms and suites were designed by architect Andre Fu, pairing New York glamour with Shenzhen's energy.

findings.quote: Designed by architect André Fu, harmonizes New York timeless glamour with Shenzhen dynamic energy

claims.text: Rooms feature dark oak parquet, dusty grey veneer and Carrara marble, with oriental-inspired timber screens and marquetry headboards.

findings.quote: The rooms feature dark oak parquet, dusty grey veneer, and Carrara marble, with highlights like oriental-inspired timber screens, bronze and glass wall sconces, and intricate marquetry on the headboard

claims.text: Floor-to-ceiling windows in the rooms frame views of the city or Qianhai Bay.

findings.quote: Floor-to-ceiling windows frame sweeping views of the city or Qianhai Bay

claims.text: Yan Ting serves classic Cantonese dishes reimagined with modern artistry, led by Chinese Executive Chef Watson Chen.

findings.quote: Helmed by the acclaimed Chinese Executive Chef and culinary talent Watson Chen, Yan Ting serves classic Cantonese dishes that are reimagined with modern artistry

claims.text: The Drawing Room in the lobby serves afternoon tea every afternoon as a tribute to Caroline Astor.

findings.quote: Indulge in a luxurious experience at our elegant lobby venue
findings.note: Drawing Room is the lobby venue

findings.quote: Every afternoon, immerse yourself in our modern interpretation of Afternoon Tea, a tribute to the refined legacy of Caroline Astor from the early 1900s

claims.text: The St. Regis evening ritual is performed in the Great Hall on the 35th floor every evening.

findings.quote: This St. Regis ritual will be performed at the Great Hall at the 35th floor every evening at 6:00 PM.

claims.text: The evening ritual is a sabrage ceremony celebrating the transition from day to evening.

findings.quote: The St. Regis Shenzhen Bao’an honors this tradition and performs the sabrage ceremony to celebrate the transition from day to evening.

claims.text: St. Regis Butler Service is offered at the hotel.

findings.quote: Enjoy the St. Regis Butler Service, a personalized signature offering of the brand

claims.text: The hotel has one indoor pool.

findings.quote: Yes, The St. Regis Shenzhen Bao'an has one Indoor pool on-site for hotel guests.

findings.quote: Shenzhen Uniwalk Qianhai, OH Bay, Nantou Ancient City, Xiwan Mangrove Park, Bay Opera of Shenzhen and more are nearby

claims.text: The St. Regis Bar's Bay Mary cocktail blends lychee and osmanthus as the hotel's twist on the St. Regis Bloody Mary.

findings.quote: including the Bay Mary – a distinctive blend of lychee and osmanthus that also serves as the hotel’s unique twist on the iconic St. Regis Bloody Mary

claims.text: At the center of The St. Regis Bar is a 4-meter-wide mural hand-painted by a local artist that tells stories of Bao'an.

findings.quote: At the center of the bar, a 4-meter-wide mural hand-painted by a local artist tells the untold stories of Bao’an

claims.text: The St. Regis Astor Terrace Bar is on an outdoor rooftop terrace with a cylindrical bar and views of the bay.

findings.quote: St. Regis Astor Terrace Bar highlights the beauty and tranquility of the outdoor rooftop terrace
The cylindrical bar serves as a visual focal point, while the outdoor seating area creates a relaxed and leisurely atmosphere. As guests savor their drinks, they can enjoy stunning views of the bay.

claims.text: The Caroline Astor Suite is a bay-view suite with views of the bay, the Bay Glory Ferris wheel and the Bao'an coastal skyline.

findings.quote: the bay view suite at 90 sqm, offering breathtaking views of the azure bay, the Bay Glory Ferries wheel, and the coastal skyline of the center of Bao’an distrcit
